title: The Eferave
description: The Eferave is a floating wild dimension.
body:
**The Eferave** is a dimension in the sky that can be accessed with a flint and tear. You can craft this with a flint and a ghast tear and use it above y=300.

The dimension only contains one biome for now but two more biomes are planned in the future.

The biome that is present right now is the Eferave plains: a vast land roamed with buffalos and ostriches. You can also find a quite rare Arachnyd Boss which allows you to create an invisibility cloak !

This mod is developped using MCreator
